title: Preparing Tomorrow's Digital Workforce: A Look at Symbiosis Centre for Information Technology Specialised M.B.A. Programmes
description: Pune (Maharashtra) [India], October 16: Symbiosis Centre for Information Technology (SCIT), a constituent of Symbiosis International (Deemed University), was set up in 1999 on a simple premise: tomorrow's business leaders need to understand technology as well as they understand strategy. Located in Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park, Hinjawadi, Pune, SCIT describes itself as a premier IT business school nurturing genuine IT talent. It now offers three M.B.A. Programmes: M.B.A. (Information Technology Business Management), M.B.A. (Data Sciences and Data Analytics) and the newly introduced M.B.A. (Artificial Intelligence in Business).
